reason: An educational utility plugin that exposes agent-callable tools for querying 64 Chinese exam schedules, calculating upcoming dates, and returning countdowns from built-in data and date rules.

summaries.zh: 提供中国考试日程查询、分类筛选和距离下一场考试天数计算的智能体工具。
summaries.en: Provides agent-callable tools to browse Chinese exam schedules, filter exam categories, and calculate the days until upcoming exams.

capabilities: Queries a built-in dataset of 64 Chinese exams
Calculates upcoming exam dates and days remaining using date rules
Filters and sorts exam results by identifier, keyword, category, and limit
